understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) attempted to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels), with moves sometimes failing due to walls/obstacles or special boundary behavior. Some adjacent objects could be pushable so moving into them might push them along, while walls generally blocked movement. When multiple selectable pieces existed, CLICK with an exact on-screen pixel position switched control to the selectable at that location; the movement.*_blocked flags were only hints and didn’t guarantee success or failure.
